article.title: Decree of foreclosure suit
article.content:
86Decree of foreclosure suit

Rep. by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908), s. 156 and V Schedule.
Note: the sub-headings “Foreclosure and Sale4” above this section carry the marker(s) footnoted here.
For the repealed provisions, as re-enacted, see (Act 5 of 1908), Sch. I, Order XXXIV.
